title: TV Ads on Demand: 5 Ways Catch-Up TV Is Changing the TV Advertising Game

facts.fact: Per the page, BVOD (Broadcast Video On Demand, also called catch-up TV) is the fastest-growing media channel in Australia.
facts.quote: In Australia, BVOD is the fastest-growing media channel—recent statistics show that nearly 2.5M Australians choose BVOD over linear TV every week.

facts.fact: The page states that nearly 2.5 million Australians choose BVOD over linear TV every week, citing unnamed 'recent statistics' that are not attributed to a source.
facts.quote: recent statistics show that nearly 2.5M Australians choose BVOD over linear TV every week.

facts.fact: The page describes traditional TV 'prime time' as 6 PM to 9 PM, when advertisers aimed to reach viewers.
facts.quote: Advertisers would scramble to get their TV advertisements in front of viewers between 6 PM and 9 PM

facts.fact: The page is published by McKenzie Partners, a Sydney advertising agency that the page states was founded in 1999.
